task.question: What was the name of the first crewed spaceflight launched by NASA in February 2026?
task.evidence: On 13 February, NASA launched the first crewed spaceflight of the year, the Crew-12 mission carrying four NASA, ESA, and Roscosmos astronauts to ISS, returning the station to its normal crew complement of seven in a rare indirect handover caused by the early return of Crew-11. The second crewed flight of the year to ISS was Soyuz MS-29 launched on 14 July and the third was Crew-13 launched on 1 October.

answer: The first crewed spaceflight launched by NASA in February 2026 was the Crew-12 mission. FINAL: Crew-12 mission

NASA and Sierra Space plan to launch Dream Chaser Demo-1, the first free flyer orbital demonstration flight of the uncrewed cargo spaceplane Dream Chaser.
On 27 February, NASA announced a number of changes to the Artemis program with the stated purpose of increasing its cadence of missions, including changing the Artemis III mission to a LEO demonstration flight, moving the first Artemis Moon landing to Artemis IV, and replacing the Exploration Upper Stage with another stage, later identified as Centaur V.
On 11 February, China performed a successful in-flight abort test of the new Mengzhou spacecraft, which verified the spacecraft's launch escape system performance, as well as the Long March 10A first stage ability of soft landing on water. Later in 2026 or possibly in 2027, China plans to launch Mengzhou 1, the first uncrewed orbital flight of the spacecraft and the complete Long March 10A rocket,
